checks.note: Published body hashes and same-identity SSR eligibility checked before load

generator.note: Outside reader/MinIO budgets; process maxRSS is a cumulative process peak, not a per-phase peak

limits: Short synthetic windows, not production SLO
Web search uses all nine source query shapes after SSR p000002 with the same identity; validates results, not unpublished tail-body reads
Independent reading is all-identity SSR p000001; Web SSR p000002 is a new common workload point, not a pure causal comparison to K3
Formal preflight does not execute the nine expensive search shapes; smoke does. Content/hash preflight and source preparation may warm host caches
Filters and identity are injected by the runner; existing Web UI support for all shapes is unverified
SSR endpoint verified; no browser hydration, rendering or human UX claim
One shared reader budget; separate larger MinIO budget does not prove MinIO is not a bottleneck
Worker deadline includes admission queue and execution; timeout is not proof of SQL execution taking four seconds
No automatic resource adjustment or lower-consumer fallback; every added phase retains the previous fixed background
All 409 remain unfulfilled user journeys requiring research/retry
